{"metadata":{"description":"一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only composer button that rewrites your prompt via the connected LLM (balanced/concise/detailed/code styles, i18n)","id":"gh:1334215346","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-prompt-polish","slug":"JoukoPuro/dsh-prompt-polish","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm","prompt"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件： 在 Web 输入框的工具行中添加一个 ✨ 图标按钮。点击后选择打磨风格，已接入的大模型 会把你草稿中的提示词改写得更专业、更易被 AI 理解 。"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin: icon-only composer button that rewrites your prompt via the connected LLM"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" (balanced/concise/detailed/code styles, i18n)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-prompt-polish"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin
that adds a ✨ sparkle button to the web composer's tool row. Click i"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"t, pick a
rewrite style, and the already-connected LLM rewrites your draft prompt to be
more profess"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ional and easier for an AI to understand — then replaces the draft
so you can review before sending."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Icon-only button** — a sparkle glyph in the composer tool row; no text,
tooltip gives the full d"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"escription.
- **Four rewrite styles** — balanced / concise / detailed / code-oriented.
- **Multi-lan"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"guage UI** — menu copy follows your browser language (zh, en, ja,
ko, fr, de, es, pt, ru, it, tr, vi"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"; falls back to English).
- **Uses your connected model** — resolves the current default agent model"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"
(`agentDefaultModel`), or an explicit `provider`/`model` from config."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) web profile running, with a model
adapter configured (e.g. t"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"he DeepSeek provider with an API key in Settings).
- Compatible with DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` through `0.2.x"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"` (declared via
`engines.dsh`). The draft source is negotiated at runtime (InputZone owner
props on "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"0.1.0, the standard-kit `useInput` hook on 0.1.5+), and icon names
are probed across both primitives"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" naming generations."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` so the profile picks up the new bundle:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Open the web UI, type a draft, and click the sparkle button in the composer
tool row."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The plugin accepts optional config in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
(user layer, applied after th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ts optional config in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`
(user layer, applied after the bundle layer):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Without `provider`/`model`, the plugin uses
`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` — the same defaul"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"t model the session
uses."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Half | File | Role |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `POST /prompt-polish` on the web server; streams one LLM rewrite"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" via `ctx.llm` |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | Registers the sparkle button into `conversation.input"},{"id":"p19s3","text":".right`; opens a style menu; posts the draft and replaces it with the polished text |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The bundle's `package.json` declares both faces of the dual-face plugin:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `dsh.bundle` — the profile patch layer (`cordis.patch.yml`) that inserts the
`prompt-polish` loade"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"r row.
- `dsh.client` — the web boot row; `client-modules` serves `lib/client.js` at
`/plugins/dsh-p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rompt-polish/client.js`."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Edit `lib/index.js` (host) and `lib/client.js` (browser). The browser bundle is
a hand-built closure"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"-factory artifact (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id,
factory })`) — keep externals limited to the "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"platform modules
(`react`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`) and inline everything else,
matc"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"hing the loader's module-table rules."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Verify on a scratch port before touching the live profile:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
